premises.text: Email is a content silo where attachments pile up and slow work despite heavy use of other cloud apps
premises.evidence_span: email is a massive content silo. Stuff just gets stuck in there

premises.text: Chrome extension connects email to cloud services so attachments move into cloud storage as links while retaining email context, including automated rules
premises.evidence_span: move these files directly into other cloud services and keep them associated with the context of the original email

premises.text: Users can attach files from the cloud with recipient-limited access-control permissions for secure sharing
premises.evidence_span: she attaches the file directly from the cloud and sets access control permissions on it

premises.text: Admin panel sets cross-application data-handling policies for teams and an event dashboard shows ownership and workflow visibility
premises.evidence_span: she sets policies across the cloud applications that they use so that she can make sure that data is being consistently handled

premises.text: Free for individuals; pay when claiming a group to govern their data workflow; Outlook support expands beyond Gmail
premises.evidence_span: Cloudless is completely free for individual users. You only pay when you claim a group of people

value.text: Secure connected enterprise cloud that controls data workflow across applications for users and IT
value.evidence_span: create a secure connected enterprise cloud and control the data workflow across many applications

causal_links.evidence_span: data is moving seamlessly from one application to another
gains visibility into who owns what data and what the data workflow is around her entire organization
meet the needs of individuals, functional groups, as well as an entire company

notes: Manual move, multi-file, and auto-rule attachment handling folded into P2 as one email-cloud mechanism. Future Salesforce/Yammer autofill examples treated as platform vision framing under value, not separate premises. Outlook availability folded into commercial/access premise P5.
